said: 2026-10-28 用户：字体设计的不好 你没什么排版规则和圣经吗 很多位置都怪怪的；做

grid.toleranceWhy: optical: a glyph inks a little inside its box (大風 set on the 120 line inks at 140)

roles.hero: 重头拍的大字，一拍一个
roles.figure: 关键数字（数字加单位），全片同一档；重头拍可用 hero
roles.title: 一拍的主句、事件名
roles.sub: 配在大字下面的小字：说明、出处、单位的展开
roles.caption: 日期、地点、说明标签；最小一档，仍要读得清

pair.order: the small line under the big one; over it only as its kicker, when the narration says it first
pair.align: same left edge (centre only on a type-only card)
pair.edgeTolWhy: a pair is set on one edge by construction (kit2 pair): a few px only — the grid tolerance of 24 hid two lines drifting 13 px apart (Suez reel, 2026-10-28)
pair.inkGapWhy: one gap between a pair's lines as the eye sees it, ink to ink, a share of the big size (the user 2026-10-28: 间隔什么的是不是也怪 应该可以更规范的); the box range stays for a greybox, which has no ink

labels: 贴在东西上的标签（地名、船名）可以钉在物体上随镜头走，字号在阶梯里、不小于 caption；关键数字和标题不钉在物体上，放在屏幕网格上
accent: 一帧一处：关键的那个数字或词

figure.why: a figure line: its figures and its words one height, inks top and foot within 5 % of its size (the user 2026-10-28: 数字和文字为什么对齐不了)

design.why: 成熟规范（TYPE.md）：层级——每帧一个先读的、最多三级、相邻两级至少 1.5 倍；接近——不同组之间至少大字的一半，组内是 0.15；字组一条轴；读速每秒 9 字（Netflix 中文）；安全区 EBU R95 / SMPTE ST 2046-1 字幕安全 90%（我们的页边 120/120/96 在其内）
